prompt: Create a four-state icon sprite sheet in the attached 4-column, 6-row lattice. Each square is 256 by 256 pixels at the requested 1024 by 1536 resolution. Each family occupies a 2 by 2 block: Light and Dark above Active and Disabled. Repeat exactly the same symbol in all four states. Fill the families shown by the guide, left to right and top to bottom. Leave unassigned squares plain white. Preserve every square position and boundary. Use solid backgrounds reaching all four edges and sharp corners. No rounded tiles, gutters, padding, margins, captions, or exterior shadows. Replace checkerboards and guide lines with artwork. If output resolution differs, scale the entire lattice uniformly.
